props.name: title
props.description: Title of the Dialog. Also serves as the aria-label for this Dialog.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: The Dialog's subtitle. Optional. Rendered below the title in smaller type with less contrast. Also serves as the aria-describedby for this Dialog.

props.name: renderHeader
props.description: Provide a custom renderer for the dialog header. This content is rendered directly into the dialog body area, full bleed from edge to edge, top to the start of the body element. Warning: using a custom renderer may violate Primer UX principles.

props.name: renderBody
props.description: Provide a custom render function for the dialog body. This content is rendered directly into the dialog body area, full bleed from edge to edge, header to footer. Warning: using a custom renderer may violate Primer UX principles.

props.name: renderFooter
props.description: Provide a custom render function for the dialog footer. This content is rendered directly into the dialog footer area, full bleed from edge to edge, end of the body element to bottom. Warning: using a custom renderer may violate Primer UX principles.

props.name: footerButtons
props.description: Specifies the buttons to be rendered in the Dialog footer.

props.name: onClose
props.description: This method is invoked when a gesture to close the dialog is used (either an Escape key press or clicking the 'X' in the top-right corner). The gesture argument indicates the gesture that was used to close the dialog (either 'close-button' or 'escape').

props.name: role
props.description: The ARIA role to assign to this dialog. See [dialog modal](https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-practices-1.1/#dialog_modal) and [alert dialog](https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-practices-1.1/#alertdialog)

props.name: width
props.description:
The width of the dialog.
small: 296px
medium: 320px
large: 480px
xlarge: 640px

Also accepts any valid CSS width value (e.g. '400px', '80rem') or a number, which is interpreted as a pixel width.

props.name: height
props.description:
The height of the dialog.
small: 296x480
large: 480x640
auto: variable based on contents

props.name: returnFocusRef
props.describedby: Return focus to this element when the Dialog closes, instead of the element that had focus immediately before the Dialog opened

props.name: initialFocusRef
props.description: Focus this element when the Dialog opens

props.name: position
props.description: The position of the dialog

props.name: align
props.description: The vertical alignment of the dialog. Only applies when position is 'center' (the default). 'top' positions the Dialog ~4rem from the top of the screen, 'center' (default) vertically centers the Dialog, 'bottom' positions the Dialog near the bottom of the screen.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS string

props.name: style
props.description: React CSS properties

props.name: onClose
props.description: Callback for closing the Dialog

props.name: buttonType
props.description: The variant of Button to use

props.name: content
props.description: The Button's inner text

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: If true, and if this is the only button with autoFocus set to true, focus this button automatically when the dialog appears.

props.name: ref
props.description: A reference to the rendered Button’s DOM node, used together with `autoFocus` for `focusTrap`’s `initialFocus`.
